summary: Tested the standalone Texting plan (backend + UI, EN + ES, phone 390px + desktop). All backend rules hold: catalog and /hosted-sms return texting {setup:200, monthly:50}. POST /hosted-sms ignores planNumber (none / Business plan number / 'new') and always returns paid 200, plan texting, planNumber null, status verify, monthly 50. Low balance returns 402 'needs $200'. Three parallel clicks charge only once. Code by call -> 123456 -> review works. Skip -> LOA (name must match) -> bill upload -> review works. Help -> admin_docs is free. Sending from a Texting-plan number returns 400 with 'receives texts only', but the error code in the response is 'bad_request', not 'receive_only'. HS.onInbound to Bob +13125558801 stores the text with charge 0, leaves the wallet unchanged and writes no transaction. UI checks that passed: landing has 4 pricing cards; the Texting card says '$200 to start · first month included, then $50/month'; Start texting -> /signup?plan=texting shows the 'Texting plan picked' banner and texting next steps; a real sign-up lands on /app/texting?start=texting with setup open. The Buy page has only the one-line link to /app/texting?add=1, which opens setup. The setup card shows the Texting plan copy, then Check number and 'Pay $200 from wallet', with no plan picker and no code/letter/bill wording before payment. Bob's 8801 panel shows the right billing line and no compose box. The Prices card shows $200 / $50 / Free. The Inbox hides the reply button for receive-only texts. The landing mockup shows incoming bubbles only. No horizontal overflow on any texting page in EN/ES at phone or desktop size. Main gap: Spanish (and French) translations are missing for post-payment and status strings.

minor.issue: Returns 400 with error 'bad_request' instead of 'receive_only'. Cause: hosted.js line 40 calls `bad(res, r.error)` without passing r.code. Fix: `bad(res, r.error, 400, r.code || 'bad_request')`.

plansFor() pushes texting entries with price: TEXTING.extra, which is undefined since TEXTING only has setup and monthly. start() still calls plansFor() but never uses the result (wasted DB queries) and still has dead plan_inactive / plan_limit / pick_plan branches.

ui_bugs.issue: Untranslated in ES/FR: 'Active for texting', 'Under review · 1–3 business days', 'Not approved · refunded'. Seen live in Spanish in the list and panel status.

English shown in Spanish: LOA intro ('Enter the details exactly as on your phone bill…' with a stray 'y'), every holder field label and hint (Account holder’s full name, As on the phone bill, Business name (optional), Street address, Service address on the bill, State / province, ZIP / postal code, Current phone provider, Account number (optional), From the bill), the bill intro ('Upload a recent phone bill for … showing the holder name y service address…'), the approval-time line, and the toasts 'Letter signed. Last step: your phone bill', 'Support has your request — we also emailed the team', 'Sent to the carrier for review' and 'Use PDF, JPG or PNG files under 5 MB.'

Untranslated in ES/FR: 'Cancel & refund $200' (texting-cancel-button), the review Info text ('Ownership confirmed with the code. Your number is…' / 'Your documents are…'), the toast 'Ownership confirmed. No letter or bill needed', and Thread 'No texts yet.'

issues: The Spanish word for wallet is inconsistent: 'monedero' in the plan note and refund line, 'Billetera' in the Wallet link and nav.
The onboarding modal 'What will you use CloudIVR for?' opens over the already-open Texting setup. Consider preselecting 'Business texting' or skipping the modal when plan=texting.
